=== for your own scripts
$ orion-agent emit --severity error --event backup.failed "nightly backup failed"
   ✓ Sent

$ orion-agent run-job --name nightly-backup -- /usr/local/bin/backup.sh
dumping 4 databases …
uploading to s3://backups … done

   ✓ nightly-backup  exit 0 · 41 s · 214 lines shipped · heartbeat ok  ← proposed

$ orion-agent run-job --name nightly-backup -- false
   ✗ nightly-backup  exit 1 · 12 ms · heartbeat failed  ← proposed
$ echo $?
1   the job's own exit code, always

--- notes
NOTE Invisible when it works: The command's own output is passed through unchanged, so cron mail looks as before.
NOTE One summary line: Proposed: a single line on stderr with exit code, duration, lines shipped and heartbeat result. Shipping problems are warnings and never change the exit code.
